main_text.p: A frigido Experientiæ quoque testimonium hic il-lustre est in vento Borea naturâ frigido & s ficcoficco,quo omniaquàm diutissimè imputria nib:l pu-trefieri a-durant. Siccarnes & alia, quæcunque al- ptum eflferuari ab hominibus affolent, sale, muria, a-ceto, vel alio quopiam ex iis, quæ siccandi naturam habent, commodè præparantur. Galenus 1. de temper. & passim alibi. Calida autem & humida facilimè putrefcere, nifi re-frigerari ac exiccari contigerit, idé 2. de febr. Siccitatesdifferentiis fafius explicat. Qua de causa imbribusetiam Hippocrates ficcitates imbribus falu-cur falu-briores multo existere non fine ratione scri-briores?psit 3.lib.aphor.15. In ficcitatibus enim super-fluxus humiditates diffoluuntur & absorben-tur, perimbres autem in corpore collecta putrefiunt,nifi quis fingulis diebus collectas exercitiis expurget,vel purgantib° pharma-cis exturbet, veletiam per balnea euacuet, vbi tamen diæte & confuetudinis ratio, commoda ac incommoda exactè cogno-scenda sunt.

De coruiCorui cibis omninò abdicantur ob pabu-lum, quod magna ex parte ex hominum,alio-memora-rumque animantium cadaueribus affumunt: biliasi quis tamen horum efui sensim affueuerit, comperiet,folidi eos esse & firmi nutrimen-ti, licet non ita fuauis fint fucci. page.notes: The left margin carries short side words (A frigido, ficco, nib:l pu-, trefieri a-, ptum efl, Siccitates, imbribus, cur falu-, briores?, De corui, memora-, bilia), copied as far as legible; several are cut or blurred and may be incomplete. "fluxus" is uncertain and should be checked: the scan reads "fluæ" or "fluz". "super-" and "exturbet" are uncertain. The reference mark in "Galenus" line is printed in the text column. The running head reads "DE VITA" as printed.
